text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Surpassing my limits, shattering common sense...
I'm gonna become the ace of the race!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Let's go seize our dream together.
Surpass it, shatter it, and overtake it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
